pk.context: 1 mg oral, steady state, healthy adults

pill.desc: light blue, capsule-shaped, biconvex, film-coated tablet

tell: A nicotinic partial agonist that is barely metabolized, with 92% of a dose excreted unchanged in urine.

clues.text: Systemic availability is about 90%, and food does not affect oral bioavailability. Protein binding is low, at 20% or less, and about 92% of a dose is excreted unchanged in urine.
A tartrate salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 211.26. It is highly soluble in water.
An NDA tablet in 0.5 mg and 1 mg strengths, supplied in 4-week starting and continuing cards.
No boxed warning. Contraindicated after serious hypersensitivity or skin reactions; nausea and abnormal dreams are most common.
It binds with high affinity and selectivity to α4β2 nicotinic receptors, acting as a partial agonist that blocks nicotine's effects.
The generic name begins with V and has eleven letters.
